recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-50439 unless OO later decides to replace the diagram source-of-truth or make the diagram relationships machine-readable conformance content.
issue_request: FHIR-50439 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking the Device module diagram to correct Observation relationships: Observation.subject should point to Patient and Device as alternatives, and Observation.device should appear pointing to Device or DeviceMetric as alternatives.
initial_application: Jira FHIR-50439 says the issue was applied in commit ff73a37. Commit ff73a37610 added images/DeviceModule.svg, registered DeviceModule.svg in publish.ini, and changed source/device-module.html to use the SVG plus representative-relationship wording. The commit message named FHIR-50445, but FHIR-50439 comments identify the same SVG batch as its application.
additional_context: The Device module page and image are in current build scope through publish.ini. The current Observation source already supports Observation.subject targeting Patient and Device and Observation.device targeting Device and DeviceMetric. FHIR-50445 is a same-diagram-family issue already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-50446 is adjacent Device module text work already represented separately.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The accepted source state is already present, and the remaining artifact is a diagram/SVG surface; the run guardrail says not to make a source-changing commit whose only edits would be generated-looking diagram artifacts when authoritative source already conveys the correct semantics.
